Class MainController

java.lang.Object
MainController
public class MainController extends Object
We have our beginning section here which is the main controller for both JavaFX GUI and Operations for the rest of the project to change entries for Narrative Container.

This Class also accesses the user authentication and connection to the MySQL Database (NarrativeContainerDB), Uses CRUD Operations to change entries information, a batch upload can be used or manual entry, text files and database are synced with local CSV (Characters.txt)

    • updateCharacter

      public boolean updateCharacter(List<Characters> currentList, String nextVersionID, String state, String loc, String imp, String desc)
      Commits a newly incremented character ID as a new entry and inserts it into the database
      Parameters:

      nextVersionID - The new ID Incremented from the previous version, ("1.2" --> "1.3" for example)

      imp - Importance State
      desc - Character backstory
      Returns:

    • IsDuplicate

      public String IsDuplicate(String targetID, List<Characters> existingList)
      The custom method for incrementing ID inputs that exists and increments to the next available ID (1 + .1), uses targetID to see ID number, existingList to see if it exists as ID already, and then uses IDExists to actually set the new increment.
      Parameters:
      targetID - The ID being chosen
      existingList - Current list ID is being checked agaisnt Characters
      Returns:
      If new number is used during the inserted ID targetID it will be kept like that, if it was existing will be incremented

    • parseBatchLine

      public boolean parseBatchLine(String rawLine, List<Characters> currentList)
      Parses with commas separating each attribute from the imported text file, checks for IsDuplicate(String, List) duplicate IDs and adds to the new Characters to currentList
      Parameters:
      rawLine - Formated text line as ID, State, Location, Importance, Description
      currentList - The list being parsed to Characters
      Returns:
      true if the lines being parsed was successful, false if soemthing is wrong with a line will not add that line.
